%0 Journal Article
%A Zhang W
%A Li M
%A Chen H
%T Acupuncture for chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting in lung cancer: a randomized controlled trial.
%J Support Care Cancer
%D 2023
%V 31
%N 5
%P 1201-1210
%R 10.1007/s00520-023-01234-5
%M 37123456
%X BACKGROUND: Chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting (CINV) remains a major burden. This randomized trial evaluated acupuncture as an adjunct in lung cancer patients. METHODS: 120 patients were randomized. RESULTS: The acupuncture group showed significantly lower CINV incidence. CONCLUSION: Acupuncture reduced CINV severity.
%K acupuncture
%K CINV
%K lung neoplasms

%A Yang, Xiaohong

%T Xiaoai Jiedu Recipe combined with chemotherapy for advanced non-small cell lung cancer: a randomized clinical trial
%J Chinese Journal of Integrative Medicine
%D 2024
%V 30
%N 2
%P 145-153
%R 10.1007/s11655-023-9876-5
%M 38234567
%X OBJECTIVE: To evaluate Xiaoai Jiedu Recipe combined with chemotherapy in advanced NSCLC. METHODS: 80 patients were randomized. RESULTS: The treatment group showed improved objective response rate and quality of life.
%K Xiaoai Jiedu Recipe
%K non-small cell lung cancer
%K randomized controlled trial

%X PURPOSE: To evaluate acupuncture for chemotherapy induced nausea and vomiting (CINV) in lung cancer. METHODS: 200 patients. RESULTS: Acupuncture significantly reduced CINV.
